response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) as invoice_count FROM Invoices i INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) as avg_count FROM gender_counts), above_average AS (SELECT gc.invoice_count, (gc.invoice_count - oa.avg_count) as excess FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE gc.invoice_count > oa.avg_count) SELECT AVG(invoice_count) as avg_of_counts, AVG(excess) as avg_of_excesses FROM above_average
